info.title: SMART CRM AI API
info.description: Public REST API of SMART CRM AI. Authenticate with an organization API key (Bearer sck_...). See docs/API.md for webhooks and signature verification.

servers.description: Relative to your SMART CRM AI host

post.description: Scope: contacts:write. Emits the contact.created webhook event.

patch.description: Scope: contacts:write. Emits the contact.updated webhook event.

post.description: Scope: deals:write. Emits the deal.created webhook event.

get.description: Scope: tasks:read. Ordered by due date (tasks without a due date last).

post.description: Scope: tasks:write. The assignee is notified.

apiKey.description: Organization API key created in Settings → API keys.

RateLimitRemaining.description: Requests left in the current window

RateLimitReset.description: Unix time (seconds) when the current window ends

Unauthenticated.description: Missing, malformed, revoked or expired API key

Forbidden.description: Missing scope, plan feature, or organization suspended

NotFound.description: Not found (or belongs to another organization)

ContactCreate.description: At least one of firstName, lastName, email or phone is required. Unknown fields are ignored.

phone.description: Any common format; normalized to E.164

ownerId.description: User id of a member of the organization

customFields.description: Validated against the organization's custom field definitions

ContactPatch.description: Partial update. Omitted fields keep their value; customFields are merged with the stored values. Unknown fields are rejected (422).

phone.description: Any common format; normalized to E.164

ownerId.description: User id of a member of the organization

customFields.description: Validated against the organization's custom field definitions

WebhookEvent.description: Body of an outbound webhook POST. Verify X-SmartCRM-Signature (t=<unix>,v1=hex(HMAC_SHA256(secret, '<t>.<body>'))).

DealPatch.description: Only the fields sent are changed. Moving to another stageId records stage history; moving to a won/lost stage closes the deal.

dueAt.description: ISO 8601 with offset; stored at minute precision. A reminder is scheduled at the due time.
ISO 8601 with offset; stored at minute precision. A reminder is scheduled at the due time.

TaskPatch.description: Only the fields sent are changed. `status` completes, reopens, starts or cancels the task.
